config.openorigins.badger_backdrop_hint: Flat backdrop with cut corners behind the task HUD
config.openorigins.hud_position_hint: Which corner shows the task HUD
config.openorigins.title_join_button_hin: Quick-join icon on the title screen
config.openorigins.pause_config_button_h: Config icon in the pause menu
config.openorigins.extrap_ms_hint: Forward render time for custom-mob bodies. Start around half your ping + 75.
config.openorigins.scan_key_hint: Debug key for entity dumps (rebind by clicking)
config.openorigins.servers_hint: One server address per row. Empty list = patches apply on every connected server. Handshake-verified Origin servers always apply.
config.openorigins.use_handshake_hint: Automatic mode: patches apply on handshake-verified Origin servers. Turning it off is not recommended; the address list below is used only when off.
feature.openorigins.debug_logging.desc: Verbose diagnostic logging (spammy, off by default).
feature.openorigins.outbox_hud.desc: Bottom-right monitor of requests sent to the server, with 1m / 30m / session rates (off by default).
feature.openorigins.allay_arms_fix.desc: Shifts custom allay arm models into place. The server sends arm parts detached, on every client version.
feature.openorigins.entity_extrapolation: Renders custom-mob bodies ahead to match server hitboxes.
Helps fighting Grimes. Recommended only on a stable connection. May overshoot on sharp turns; toggle live with the hotkey to compare.

screen.openorigins.config.title: OpenOrigin config
button.openorigins.quickjoin_hint:
Left-click: join Origin Realms
Right-click: open config
toast.openorigins.outdated: Your OpenOrigins is too old! Please update to use server features.
feature.openorigins.location_tracker.des: Shows your current location in Discord status.
feature.openorigins.enhanced_cosmetics.d: Answers the server handshake and enables server-driven cosmetics. Applies after reconnect.
feature.openorigins.smooth_animations.de: Interpolates armor stand poses for silky animations.
feature.openorigins.block_enhancements.d: Fixes custom-block flicker and blocks useless right-clicks.
feature.openorigins.expand_model_boundin: Keeps large models rendered at screen edges and from afar.
feature.openorigins.hide_names.desc: Hides name tags when the HUD is hidden (F1).
feature.openorigins.auction_ping.desc: Plays a sound and shows a toast when your auction lot sells.
feature.openorigins.cutscene_enhancement: Locks FOV to 70 and freezes mouse look during cutscenes.
feature.openorigins.custom_item_ids.desc: Shows real custom ids (originrealms:...) in advanced tooltips.
feature.openorigins.scoreboard_desync_fi: Tolerates stale scoreboard team packets instead of disconnecting.
Tolerates duplicate registry entries from the server instead of disconnecting.
feature.openorigins.badger_task_hud.desc: Shows the active badger task requirements on the HUD.
feature.openorigins.oa_emoji_picker.desc: Chat emoji grid backed by config/openorigins/emoji.json (OriginAddons-style).
feature.openorigins.oa_block_picker.desc: Middle-click picks custom blocks by matching inventory items.
feature.openorigins.helmet_cosmetic_slot: Shows helmet cosmetic in a separate slot, real helmet in the helmet slot.
If the helmet is missing or wrong, take the item off and put it back on.
Strict recipe-book matching for custom items.
Custom items only satisfy matching custom inputs (by polymer id). Removes false positives (banana box as paper) but may hide crafts the server would accept.
feature.openorigins.moa_facing_fix.desc: Turns the Moa mount body to face the direction of travel. The server assembled it backwards (visual only).
feature.openorigins.break_sync.desc: Animates custom-block cracks to match server break time. The server freezes client progress via block_break_speed; learned per-block, per-tool durations fill the gap (visual only, never finishes early).
